fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled input bytes are parsed as the uSWID header; hdrver, hdrsz, payloadsz, flags, and compression are extracted from the raw file.

fine_trace.code: payload = fu_input_stream_read_bytes(stream, offset + hdrsz, payloadsz, error);
fine_trace.note: The uncompressed payload (attacker-controlled CBOR coSWID bytes) is read from the file at offset hdrsz with length payloadsz.

fine_trace.code: fw2 = fu_bytes_new_offset(payload, offset_tmp, payloadsz - offset_tmp, error);
fine_trace.note: The payload bytes are handed to fu_coswid_firmware_parse as a GBytes blob for CBOR decoding.
The root CBOR map contains an Entity tag (ID=2); its value (a map) is dispatched to fu_coswid_firmware_parse_entity.

For each single-uint Role tag (ID=32) in the entity map, the role value is written into roles[entity_role_cnt++] with NO bounds check against the 6-element roles array; 7 or more such tags overflow the heap-allocated FuCoswidFirmwareEntity struct, causing a heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 4.
